attributes.residual: Exactly two words, fully named, 0 STRUCTURAL rows: target loads the 0.5 constant AFTER the cos call into scratch f3 (`lfd f3,lbl_80345F18` at +0x41c) and uses f3 for both the fmul at +0x424 and the fmadd at +0x42c; ours loads it BEFORE the call into callee-saved f27 (+0x410) and uses f27 at both sites. The tension is two-variable and now measured from both sides: a NAMED local is required for the fmadd to fuse, but a named local initialized before the expression has a live range crossing the call and is therefore given a callee-saved home; direct reads move neither defect. Six distinct spellings are now dead across two sessions (three in the superseded record, three here), so the source axis is closed at the per-cluster cap.
